h1: Orion Healing Centre — a beachfront yoga & detox retreat in Sri Thanu, Koh Phangan
intro: Picture an open-sided yoga shala sitting right at the water's edge, where you roll out your mat in the morning light with the Gulf of Thailand in front of you — Orion Healing Centre is a wellness retreat built around yoga, detox and recovery on Sri Thanu Beach, on the quieter west coast of Koh Phangan, the island's wellness zone well away from the Full Moon crowds. There's a saltwater pool, a sauna and herbal steam room, a private beach, a vegan restaurant and daily yoga classes, all in an alcohol-free setting. Around 25 rooms and bungalows, with rustic fan-cooled bamboo huts starting from about ฿1,500/night in normal season.

body.html: Orion isn't the kind of resort you check into just to lie around — it's a wellness centre where most guests come for a yoga or detox program. It sits on Sri Thanu Beach on the west coast of Koh Phangan, the island's wellness district dotted with health cafes, vegan kitchens and yoga studios. The thing nearly every review mentions first is the open-sided yoga shala that sits right at the water's edge — you practise looking out over the Gulf of Thailand, catching both the morning light and the sunset. Many guests call it one of the most beautiful beachfront shalas on the island.

There are several room tiers to match your budget. The most affordable is a fan-cooled bamboo hut of around 14 sq m, with a bed, a wall fan and a hot-water shower, tucked into the coconut garden near the restaurant and shala — genuinely simple, retreat-style living. If you want air-conditioning and more comfort, the newer Superior/Deluxe rooms and Zen bamboo bungalows come with A/C, en-suite bathrooms, a small fridge and a terrace with a hammock. Just go in knowing that this is retreat accommodation, not a standard 3-star hotel room — some reviews note the rooms are starting to look tired in places, so if comfort matters, book an air-conditioned Deluxe.
"A few steps from my room to the beachfront shala for sunrise yoga with the sound of the waves, then vegan food that was far better than I expected — a week here genuinely felt like a body reset."

The heart of Orion is its wellness programs and facilities. There are daily yoga classes, Yoga Teacher Training courses, 11- to 28-night detox programs and Reiki classes. Facilities include a saltwater pool, sauna and herbal steam room, an ice bath, a massage area and a private beach. The restaurant is largely vegan, and it earns a lot of praise in reviews — many guests say the food is good enough that it never feels like restriction. The overall mood is calm, recovery-focused and community-driven, with travellers from many countries meeting along the way.

A few things to be honest about. First, communication and admin can be patchy — several reviews, including recent ones, mention slow email replies, mixed-up room assignments or late information, so confirm your booking and room details in writing before you travel. Second, there has been on-and-off construction at times, which can disturb the peace you're paying for, so it's worth asking about construction status before booking. Third, paths to the inner bungalows can be poorly lit at night — solo travellers should bring a torch or use a phone light.

One more thing to set expectations: Orion is an alcohol-free, wellness-focused space with vegan food and no party bar. If you're here to slow down, do yoga, detox or properly reset, that's a plus; if you want a resort with a beach bar and a varied buffet, this isn't it. The overall score sits around 8.6, and it holds a Tripadvisor 4.5/5 from over 344 reviews as a wellness centre — which tells you that people who match its style mostly leave delighted, while the criticism tends to come from those expecting a hotel rather than a retreat.

Bottom line: Orion Healing Centre stands out for its beachfront yoga shala, its yoga and detox programs, its vegan food and its calm wellness atmosphere on Sri Thanu, all at a price you can reach from a humble bamboo hut upward. It suits yoga lovers, anyone wanting to detox or reset, and solo travellers looking for a wellness community. But if you're after an easygoing resort with a bar and varied activities, or you're not into the vegan/alcohol-free lifestyle, consider a more conventional Sri Thanu resort instead.

A tip from reading the real reviews: if you're coming for a yoga or detox program, booking direct with the centre to bundle stay + classes is usually better value than booking a room alone. For a general stay, choose an air-conditioned Deluxe for comfort and confirm room details in writing. Sri Thanu has cafes, vegan restaurants and yoga studios within walking distance, so leave an evening free to explore the wellness village around you.

But accept that this is retreat-style lodging: some rooms are tired, admin can be patchy, and it's an alcohol-free, vegan space rather than a conventional holiday resort.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Orion Healing Centre Koh Phangan

faq.q: Where is Orion Healing Centre and how do you get there?
faq.a: Orion is on Sri Thanu Beach, on the west coast of Koh Phangan. From Thong Sala Pier (the main pier) it's about a 20–25 minute drive. Sri Thanu is the island's wellness zone, with vegan restaurants, cafes and yoga studios within roughly 100–300 m walking distance, and it's a fair way from Haad Rin and the Full Moon Party.

faq.q: What are the starting prices and room types at Orion Healing Centre?
faq.a: In normal season it starts at about ฿1,500/night for a fan-cooled bamboo hut. Air-conditioned Superior rooms run around ฿2,200, Deluxe around ฿2,800, and Zen bamboo bungalows around ฿3,200. Prices swing by season and Full Moon nights, and if you book a yoga/detox package it bundles stay + classes — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Orion Healing Centre best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for yoga lovers, anyone wanting to detox or reset, and solo travellers seeking a wellness community. It's all about a calm atmosphere, vegan food and an alcohol-free setting. It's not for people who want a resort with a beach bar and varied activities, or a fresh, modern hotel room.

faq.q: What yoga and detox programs does Orion offer?
faq.a: There are daily yoga classes, Yoga Teacher Training courses, 11- to 28-night detox programs and Reiki classes, along with facilities like a beachfront yoga shala, a saltwater pool, a sauna and herbal steam room, and an ice bath. If you're coming for a program, booking direct with the centre to bundle stay + classes is usually better value.

faq.q: Is Orion really alcohol-free and vegan?
faq.a: Yes. Orion is an alcohol-free, wellness-focused space and its restaurant is largely vegan, with the food earning praise in many reviews. There's no party bar like a typical resort. If you love a healthy lifestyle that's a plus; if you want to drink or eat a varied menu, consider another stay.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, and what should I watch out for?
faq.a: For high season (Dec–Feb) and course/retreat dates, book 1–2 months ahead, as there are only around 25 rooms. The main thing to watch is that reviews flag slow communication and mixed-up room assignments — confirm room, program and price in writing before you travel, and ask about any construction/renovation status.
